name: Rack Centre LGS1
notes: Carrier-neutral Tier III constructed-facility-certified data centre at Oregun, Lagos; connected to all five undersea cables (ACE, GLO1, MainOne, SAT-3, WACS); ~1.5MW installed in first facility; commenced operation 2023.

name: Rack Centre LGS2
notes: AI-ready LGS2 data center at Oregun, Lagos, launched April 2025 with ~12MW IT load capacity, complementing LGS1's 1.5MW.

name: Equinix (MainOne) LG1 / MDX-I Lekki
notes: Tier III certified MDX-I Lekki data centre next to MainOne's cable landing station with access to the 1.92Tbps international subsea cable; part of Equinix Lagos campus.

name: Equinix (MainOne) LG2 Lekki
notes: International Business Exchange (IBX) at Lekki, Lagos; ~644 m2 colocation space, floor load 10 kN/m2; part of Equinix Lagos campus.

name: Equinix LG3 Victoria Island
notes: Four-storey ~$22M new-build data centre at Victoria Island, Equinix's first newly constructed facility in West Africa; initially slated to open 2025, still under construction; targeting >99.999% uptime.

name: Digital Realty LOS1 (Medallion)
notes: Cloud-neutral/carrier-neutral colocation at 8A Saka Tinubu St, Victoria Island; ~200 m2 whitespace; major internet peering point.

name: Digital Realty LOS2 (Medallion)
notes: Second Victoria Island facility of Digital Realty's interconnected Lagos campus; colocation from single cabinets to full suites.

name: Digital Realty LKK1 (Medallion Lekki)
notes: Compact data centre at Medallion Lane/Okun Ajah Rd, Lekki; ~260 m2, scalable colocation options.

name: Digital Realty LKK2 (Medallion Lekki)
notes: Second Lekki compact facility supporting regional digital growth.

name: NTT DATA Internet Solutions data centre
notes: Tier III energy-efficient data centre at Victoria Island, Lagos.

name: Africa Data Centres LOS1 Lagos
notes: Rated-3 facility in Eko Atlantic special economic zone; official spec: 10 data halls, 9,800 m2 white space, 20.65MW critical IT load; announced 2021 as a 10MW facility; West African hub of Africa Data Centres pan-African network.

name: OADC Lagos (LOS1) Lekki
notes: Tier III facility at Lekki, Lagos; first pan-African network of data centres certified by Uptime Institute.

name: OADC Ilasan Data Centre
notes: 24MW facility at Ilasan, Lagos; phase 1 (12MW) under construction, expected live in 2026; part of ~60MW committed OADC pipeline in Lagos.

name: MTN Sifiso Dabengwa Data Centre
notes: Launched 2025 at Ajao Road, Lagos; phase 1 provides 4.5MW IT load and ~780 racks with Tier III accreditation; phase 2 to take capacity to 14-20MW; total investment for both phases ~$235M.

name: MTN Ikoyi Switch
notes: Network switch/node data centre at Ikoyi, Lagos, part of MTN's network infrastructure.

name: MTN Ojota Data Centre
notes: Data centre at Ikorodu Road, Ojota, Lagos, offering cloud, IoT and colocation services via submarine cable infrastructure.

name: Nxtra Lagos Data Centre Park (Eko Atlantic)
notes: Hyperscale data centre at Eko Atlantic, Lagos; ~34MW (some sources cite 38MW) supporting 3,000+ racks at up to 30kW/rack; expected operational by end-2026; first of five planned Airtel hyperscale data centres in Africa and set to be Nigeria's largest.

name: Kasi Cloud LOS1 (Lekki)
notes: $250M, 100MW AI-focused hyperscale campus on 42 hectares in Lekki, Lagos; ground broken April 2022, construction from Q2 2023; first phase of the 100MW AI-ready campus commissioned May 2026; designed for high-density GPU racks up to 100kW.

name: Fringe Ikoyi Metro EDGE
notes: Fringe Africa's first EDGE data centre at Ikoyi, Lagos; 1MW behind-the-meter capacity, up to 72 racks; launched January 2026; company plans five facilities across regional cities by 2030.

name: Excelsimo Networks Data Centre
notes: Tier III colocation/cloud/managed services facility at Gbagada, Lagos, with redundant network, cooling and fire suppression.

name: ipNX Data Centre
notes: Data centre at Victoria Island, Lagos, providing hosting/colocation for enterprises.

name: INQ.Digital Nigeria data centre
notes: Tier III accredited facility at Ikoyi, Lagos, offering edge AI/IoT, SDN/NFV and edge cloud services.

name: 21st Century Technologies data centre
notes: Colocation/data centre services at 5 Jeremiah Ugwu Street, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos; one of Nigeria's top-10 colocation operators.
